description: A rich and savory French rillettes dish featuring turnips, mustard, and a sweet lacquer glaze, perfect for a solo dinner. The combination of earthy turnips and flaky texture makes for a delightful and comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Lacquer glaze (see notes)
ingredients.notes: Make by cooking 1/4 cup honey, 1/4 cup soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons rice vinegar to 225275F.

instructions: Peel and dice the turnips, then place them in a large saucepan and cover them with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until the turnips are tender, about 30 minutes.
Drain the turnips and let them cool to room temperature.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly add the milk, whisking constantly, and bring to a simmer. Cook until the mixture thickens, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked turnips to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a loaf pan and smooth the top.
Refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, slice the rillettes thinly and arrange on a platter. Drizzle with lacquer glaze and garnish with parsley.
